description: COALESCE widens across its arguments' types instead of taking only the first non-unknown argument's type

columns.name: d
columns.note: the literal 0 (int64) widens against discount (decimal); PostgreSQL resolves COALESCE(0, discount) to numeric

name: coalesce_widens_to_decimal
query_sql:
-- @name GetEffectiveDiscount
-- @returns :many
SELECT COALESCE(0, discount) AS d FROM order_items
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE order_items (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, discount NUMERIC)
